apple.name: Quiet Camp
apple.subtitle: Tents and Trees puzzle
apple.description: Place exactly one tent next to each tree, satisfy every row and column total, and keep tents from touching, diagonally included. Solve eight original, uniquely solvable 5×5 and 6×6 boards. Mark grass, undo, restart, and keep your progress on this device. There is no timer or score penalty.
